== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Soulsmiths]] are specialized craftsmen who manipulate [[madra]] to work with the essence of spirits. Their primary role involves deconstructing and reconstructing [[Remnants]]—living forces left behind by deceased [[sacred artists]]—to utilize their unique properties. Through this process, they can create various items, including weapons, armor, prosthetic limbs, and complex [[constructs]]. They are also capable of [[binding]] spiritual components to physical vessels or transplanting [[binding|bindings]] into [[sacred artists]]. The craft requires a combination of [[Forging]] skills, a sharp memory, and intense dedication to experimentation. Successful [[Soulsmithing]] involves blending three essential elements: the [[binding]], the physical material of the [[construct]], and the Soulsmith's own [[madra]]. Because [[madra]] is a living, changing substance, practitioners must be able to predict its fluctuations to ensure compatibility and safety; failure to do so can result in useless products or dangerous malfunctions. [[Soulsmiths]] utilize specialized tools, most notably a [[drudge]]—a personalized [[construct]] that assists with measuring [[madra]] and analyzing [[Remnant]] components. They also use hammers to inject their [[willpower]] into objects and [[Spirit-seals|spirit-seals]] to weaken [[Remnants]] for dissection. Advanced practitioners may use a [[Soulforge]] to imbue items with the [[Authority|authority]] of higher existences. While their skills are not directly combat-oriented, [[Soulsmiths]] are highly valued assets to clans and sects, often serving as significant sources of income.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Soulsmiths]] are specialized craftsmen who work within a foundry to manipulate the essence of spirits. This discipline requires immense delicacy and skill to manage complex [[binding|bindings]], as well as a sharp memory and a dedication to constant experimentation. Through their craft, they forge weapons, form various [[constructs]], and even steal [[binding|bindings]] from [[Remnants]] to transplant them into [[sacred artists]]. Highly proficient practitioners are capable of controlling many different [[constructs]] simultaneously.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Soulsmiths]] are craftsmen who work with the stuff of spirits.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|A Soulsmith is a professional title for those who practice the art of soulsmithing, which involves reshaping [[madra]] other than their own to give power a specific form. This process requires the practitioner to maintain compatibility between their own power and that of the [[construct]] being created, often utilizing [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] for their specialized tools. Within this discipline, individuals like [[Fisher Gesha|Gesha]] employ these techniques, and a Soulsmith may even be responsible for overseeing the operations of a course. These practitioners can perform various tasks with a [[Sylvan Riverseed]] and may maintain an underground storehouse for their work.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmithing]] is the process of creating a [[construct]] by taking control of power and giving it form.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmithing]] requires compatibility between the [[Soulsmith]]'s power and the [[construct]]'s power.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmith]] is a title or profession.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2">''Blackflame'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Fisher Gesha|Gesha]] uses [[Soulsmith]] practice.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6">''Blackflame'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Reshaping [[madra]] besides one's own is the fundamental skill of a [[Soulsmith]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|There is a [[Soulsmith]]’s underground storehouse.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17">''Blackflame'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
